claims.statement: Settings is loaded once from the repo-root .env, ignores unknown keys, and maps nested chat fields with the __ delimiter so CHAT__<FIELD> overrides ChatSettings. A process that already called get_settings() does not reread .env until restart.
The five secret fields supabase_db_url, typesafe_api_key, xai_api_key, langfuse_public_key, and langfuse_secret_key are repr=False, so a Settings repr or failing assert does not print their values.
Chat is disabled, and chat routes return 503, when SUPABASE_DB_URL is unset or an xai: model has no XAI_API_KEY; dashboards are unaffected and a caller-supplied model still requires the database URL.

A production categorization run with no TYPESAFE_API_KEY still pairs transfers and applies rules, then skips jev and leaves unmatched rows pending; finance eval-categorization refuses to start without that key.
TrustedHostMiddleware rejects any Host outside trusted_hosts with 400, including on /health, and testserver must stay allowed because TestClient sends that Host.

same_origin returns 403 for POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE when Origin is present and not in cors_origins, while a missing Origin is allowed so CLI, curl, and tests can call unsafe methods; CORS alone does not block those requests.

Public tables have no row-level security. agent_reader is a nologin role that can SELECT only the agent views after SET LOCAL ROLE inside a read-only transaction, which does not make the single-user local app safe to host as-is. Limits also names linked issues that are not built; those issues are not shipped behavior.

category_threshold 0.95 gates only jev-sourced categories into needs_review. brand_threshold 0.5 drops a new name only when brand confidence is strictly below it. merge_threshold 0.5 and merge_suggestion_floor 0.3 are both inclusive and decide a merge versus a suggestion. subscription_threshold 0.7 is a strict greater-than that a merchant default can override.

transfer_pattern and transfer_window_days pair opposite equal amounts on different accounts from description_raw before any jev call, defaulting to a case-insensitive transfer regex and a two-day window.

ChatSettings defaults bound model choice, summary and tool-result clearing, per-turn SQL and model calls, SQL timeout and row display, pool wait, and title length, and max_model_calls_per_turn must stay strictly above max_sql_calls_per_turn.

jev receives bank, bank_concept, merchant_text, amount, and direction, plus candidate_name on a same-merchant call, and does not receive description_raw; card numbers are stripped from the structured text fields at import.

The chat model and its Langfuse callback receive the question, data context, and compact run_sql rows from agent views that include merchant names, cleaned bank text, amounts, dates, notes, and account names, and exclude ids, IBANs, and description_raw.

With Langfuse keys set, each jev call is a generation nested under a categorize or eval span, and each chat turn is one observation with deterministic scores plus a replaceable user-feedback score; without keys the client records nothing and flushes are no-ops.
jev_concurrency defaults to 8 and rejects values below 1, because a zero semaphore would wait forever for the first jev call.

The outbound privacy boundary is the code, not a copied architecture section: jev_state sends bank, bank_concept, merchant_text, amount, and direction, and does not send description_raw. Agent views expose cleaned bank text and account names, not IBANs or description_raw.
